summary: Round 1: attendance event core (BIO-ATT-001, W10.1, dependencies BIO-IDN-001 + BIO-ARC-003). AttendanceEvent (Domain/AttendanceEvent.cs) is an immutable raw fact: person_id (existence-gated live against BIO-IDN-001's PersonService, no ProjectReference), source (device/manual/import) + device_id (required iff device, shape-validated only against the canonical dev_ pattern - BIO-DEV-001 is not a declared dependency), location, mode (check_in/check_out/presence), occurred_at, and VerificationEvidence (method/verified/confidence) - AC01. It carries no status field of any kind; AttendanceStatusEvaluator is a pure (events, policy) -> DerivedAttendanceStatus function, computed fresh at read time, never persisted or cached - the identical 'compute in effect at read time' discipline BIO-IDN-002 established for time-based status, applied here for an identical reason (no scheduler infra exists) - AC02. AttendancePolicy (per-tenant, CAS-versioned) carries interpretation_mode (education/workforce/presence, MASTER-TECHNICAL-SPECIFICATION.md s10) + expected_start_time + late_grace_minutes; the identical raw event set classifies differently under two different policies, proven directly - AC04. Idempotent capture: producer-minted idempotency_key + a SHA-256 content fingerprint excluding server-stamped fields (EventId/ReceivedAt), serialized per (tenant, idempotency_key) via a dedicated lock registry BEFORE validation runs; identical redelivery replays the original event, a reused key with different content is a 409 conflict - proven under a genuine 20-way concurrent Task.WhenAll race, not just sequential re-checking - AC03.
notes: ADR-0006 applied precisely, not blanket-copied from BIO-ACC-001: capture and every read (POST /events, GET /events, GET /status, GET /policy) require only an asserted actor (audit-attribution use, Decision 2) - re-derived from this story's own data sensitivity (attendance presence/time data is comparable to PERSON's own name/DOB, not to BIO-ACC-001's access-policy rule content) rather than assumed by endpoint-shape precedent. Only PUT /policy (an authorization decision: it reclassifies every person's events tenant-wide) requires both a permission grant (IPermissionGateway wrapping BIO-IDN-006's PermissionService.ActorHasPermissionAsync) and a verified ADR-0006 Decision 3 provenance proof (Api/ActorProvenanceGate.cs, hand-ported feature-locally from BIO-ACC-001's own class, own Attendance:ActorProvenanceSecret config key). AC05: web/features/attendance/{attendance-page.tsx,ports.ts,mock.ts} are completely untouched (structurally enforced by BIO-ATT-001.test.sh). web/features/attendance/live.ts - BIO-UX-010's own scaffolding, already POSTing headerless to /api/v1/attendance/primary-action and /flag-exception per its own doc comment inviting exactly this - needed zero edits. Connected via (1) one added web/next.config.mjs rewrite entry (BIO-DOC-009-AC06's identical pattern) and (2) a dedicated AttendanceDemoBridgeService (Singleton, depends only on Singleton repositories/audit sink - no captive-dependency risk) that genuinely exercises AttendanceEvent.Capture/AttendanceStatusEvaluator.Evaluate against one fixed, already-public SYNTHETIC tenant (the literal identifier-registry.json tenant example) - not a second mock. A real bug was caught by the new host-channel test before review: the bridge's first draft passed source=Device with device_id=null, which AC01's own validation correctly rejected (422 on every call) - found by curling a real dev server rather than assuming, fixed, reverified via the same test. Verified end-to-end: dotnet build clean (0 errors); 24/24 feature-local tests; 134/134 full Biolog.IntegrationTests suite (was 128, +6 new AttendanceHostChannelTests.cs - a real capture through the packaged host reaching the real BIO-IDN-001 gateway, a real unknown-person rejection, a real idempotent-replay proof, policy-endpoint rejection on lack of authority and missing provenance same disclosed-limitation shape as AccessPolicyHostChannelTests, and the two AC05 bridge routes answering a genuinely headerless request); 33/33 offline structural checks (tests/features/bio-att-001/BIO-ATT-001.test.sh, newly registered in scripts/quality.sh along with the unit-test line and vulnerability-audit csproj pair); scripts/quality.sh QUALITY PASS (implemented-story traceability, module-reference direction, secret scan all clean; BIO-ATT-001 is outside check-traceability.py's scope, which only tracks tests/foundation/*.test.sh stories - confirmed BIO-ACC-001/BIO-CRD-007/BIO-MOB-003 share this same out-of-scope status, not an oversight). Deliberately out of scope, documented in docs/features/bio-att-001/README.md: device/lifecycle gating on capture, tenant timezones, overtime status (MASTER-TECHNICAL-SPECIFICATION.md's example goes beyond this story's own narrower AC04 wording), and BIO-ATT-002/003's own richer surfaces (all three stories share the same /attendance route/port per governance/ui-integration-map.json).
